name: Dire Stonetip
description: The spike presses slowly into a quilted coat and parts the stitching until the point meets the body beneath.

name: Fierce Pickfluke
description: The beak slips into the loose gap where a padded sleeve meets the shoulder and pricks the arm inside.

name: Rooted Backbill
description: With the rear heel set firmly and the pick held across the body, the student soaks up a pushing blow.

name: Flukebandage
description: A quick look at the stitching and thickness of a coat tells how many layers the spike must pass.

name: Peck Hammerfall
description: Qi packs the spike tip and the drive punches through quilting and padding to the flesh beneath in one hard push.

name: Tethering Spikebeak
description: The beak sinks through a padded sleeve into its lining and pins the arm against the target's own body.

name: Pickbuckle
description: The beak catches the top edge of a shield and drags it downward, opening the wearer's chest.

name: Acrid Punch
description: A low thrust sends the spike under a shield's lower rim and into the shin behind it.

name: Stalwart Pickhelve
description: The off hand braces the haft against the forearm so the pick takes a shield-shove without folding.

name: Slinking Crack
description: The student circles to the shield-bearer's weak side in short steps, always keeping the pick out of reach.

name: Alert Crowbill
description: A tap of the pick on a shield's boss and a listening ear tell where the boards are old and brittle.

name: Gripping Peckhead
description: The beak lifts a shield rim with a qi-strong tug and the spike drops over the top into the shoulder.

name: Chinkthwack
description: The hammer face lands on a weak plank with focused qi, cracking the board and numbing the arm behind it.

name: Stubborn Waistpoint
description: Both hands choke the haft to shorten the lever, so a pulled foe cannot wrench the pick away.

name: Crackbuckle
description: The beak hooks behind a collar or gorget strap and draws the target's head down and forward.

name: Lassoing Drive
description: The beak catches the back of a knee and yanks it forward so the leg buckles under the target.

name: Prowling Hardtooth
description: The student steps back through a pull, using the stride itself to add length and force to the haul.

name: Levering Chink
description: A hooked target is heaved over the planted hip by a qi-driven pull on the haft and lands hard on the ground.

name: Clutching Puncture
description: The beak anchors in a belt or harness and the student drags the foe along, holding him bound to the pick.

name: Flukeslap
description: Repeated blows of the hammer face fall on the same spot of a breastplate until the steel dishes inward.

name: Rugged Puncture
description: The spike strikes the thin upper edge of a shin plate where it overlaps the knee guard.

name: Sprig Peckhead
description: The student drops a shoulder and holds the haft across it so a charging plate-clad foe is checked.

name: Sharddrive
description: The point flicks forward at the narrow eye slit of a visor and forces the wearer to jerk back.

name: Recall Ironthorn
description: A light rap on the throat guard tells by its ring how well it is fastened and how thick it runs.

name: Draught Stonetip
description: The student draws back one pace with the beak caught on a plate edge, dragging the armored foe off his footing.

name: Rude Chink
description: A qi-charged hammer stroke lands along a line of rivets and shears them, so the plate gapes open.

name: Static Backbill
description: The spike is driven under a plate's edge and the haft is levered back, peeling the steel from its straps.

name: Waistpoint Barrier
description: Gripped near the butt, the long haft spreads across the body in a wide guard that fends off thrusts.

name: Blank Hardtooth
description: The whole length of the haft pushes through the hands and the spike reaches a foe just out of reach.

name: Brawn Punch
description: The long haft sweeps across the front and beats an enemy weapon or hand aside.

name: Grit Crack
description: A smooth backward glide keeps the long pick's reach between the student and a pressing opponent.

name: Hum Pickhelve
description: Turned in a wide circle, the long haft sweeps a spear thrust aside and brings the head round in the same motion.

name: Shard Peck
description: A qi-driven lunge sends the spike out to the full length of the haft and a hand beyond.

name: Claycrow
description: Both hands hold the haft at the middle in a balanced ready, the head rising on one side and the butt on the other.

name: Gleam Drive
description: Standing above on a slope, the student chops the beak downward at a foe below with the whole weight of the fall.

name: Stonetip Hammerfall
description: The hammer face beats across the body at an enemy's weapon arm, knocking the weapon down.

name: Hazepick
description: The haft rises level overhead in both hands and takes a downward cut on its middle.

name: Peckhurdle
description: The student steps forward with a wide base so the two-handed swing never leaves him off balance.

name: Pickfluke Bandage
description: Spreading the hands along the haft lets the student feel the exact reach of the head before he commits.

name: Brass Spikebeak
description: A full body turn whips the beak in a long arc and qi sets the spike deep into armor.

name: Brasscrow
description: The hammer face lands once, rebounds off the target on a pulse of qi, and lands again from the other side.

name: Pickbarrier
description: The haft spins in both hands in a whirling circle that fends off cuts from the front and sides.

name: Discord Crowbill
description: The beak hooks a rider's stirrup strap and tugs the foot loose from the iron.

name: Blank Pickhelve
description: A sharp prick of the spike into the rider's thigh above the boot makes him shift in the saddle.

name: Stalwart Ironthorn
description: Crouched close at the horse's flank, the student holds the pick low where the rider's weapon cannot reach.

name: Rillfluke
description: The student circles round the haunch of a mounted foe in quick steps, staying behind the rider's reach.

name: Punchscreen
description: The beak hooks a girth strap or belt under qi and a hard pull drags the rider from the saddle.

name: Hazefluke
description: The spike lodges against a passing mount's armored flank and the student shoves, turning the rush aside.

name: Shard Spikebeak
description: As the foe lifts an arm, the spike searches the open gap beneath it where plate and mail do not meet.

name: Brassdrive
description: A hard rap of the hammer face on a plate hinge's rivet loosens the joint and slows the limb.

name: Entangling Punch
description: The beak hooks the flared plate at the elbow and pulls the arm out of its guard.

name: Sleet Ironthorn
description: The student turns so his own joints stay behind the pick's head and haft and give no open seam.

name: Puncture Stalk
description: A steady heavy-footed gait suits a student in armor, keeping weight low and balance true across rough ground.

name: Crowbill Flog
description: A qi-sharpened spike drives into the knee plate's hinge and snaps the pin, leaving the joint flapping.

name: Gleampunch
description: The spike slides along a plate seam from rivet to rivet under qi, finding the gap where armor flexes.
